items.label: MA-AG civil: New Penn Financial, LLC d/b/a Shellpoint Mortgage Servicing
items.detail: Assurance of discontinuance in Suffolk Superior Court over failure to help homeowners avoid foreclosure under the 35B law; date is the announcement date. Headline says $4 million in relief; the body itemizes $3.5 million of principal reduction and shortfall waivers plus a $450,000 payment to the Commonwealth, summed here. Cash-only rule applied 2026-10-11: amount changed from 3,950,000 to 450,000; the part not counted is listed in data/manual/excluded-amounts.csv as xa-014.
